- `1m`  -  the most recent month
- `3m`  -  the most recent three months
- `6m`  -  the most recent six months
- `1y`  -  the most recent year
- `3y`  -  the most recent three years

This filters transaction dates. A narrower period can reduce the number of matches.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
**Order of the returned transactions.** Omit it for `newest`.

- `newest`  -  latest transaction date first (default)
- `oldest`  -  earliest transaction date first
- `high_price`  -  highest transaction price first
- `low_price`  -  lowest transaction price first

With **`transaction_type=sold` and `usage=commercial`**, these additional values are available:

- `high_price_per_sqft`  -  highest price per square foot first
- `low_price_per_sqft`  -  lowest price per square foot first
- `high_plot_size`  -  largest plot first
- `low_plot_size`  -  smallest plot first

Sending an additional sort for any other transaction/usage combination returns 400.
